job.title: Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineer, Ads Ranking
job.short_title: Senior Staff ML Engineer, Ads Ranking
job.pay_full: $266,000 – $372,400 USD base salary, plus restricted stock units (and, depending on the position, possibly commission)

details.about: Reddit is a community of communities, with more than 100,000 active communities and about 130 million daily active unique visitors. This hands-on technical leader sets the direction for Reddit's Core Ads Ranking and mid-funnel modeling systems, advancing user representation, graph learning and sequence modeling, and building foundational architectures used by downstream teams including Retrieval, Shopping, Click Prediction, Video View-Through Prediction, Conversion Prediction and App Ads Modeling.
duties: Define and execute the technical roadmap for Core Ads Ranking, user representation, graph learning and sequence modeling across clicks, video views and conversions
Lead work on foundational model architectures, knowledge distillation, calibration and feature/embedding development
Partner with vertical teams, data science, product and ML infrastructure on shared signals, architectures and outcomes
Use AI-assisted development tools (such as Claude and Cursor) to investigate model behavior, automate hypothesis testing and error analysis, and build reproducible experiment loops
Build evaluation frameworks covering ranking and calibration outcomes, reproducibility, latency and cost
Mentor engineers across the ads organization and guide technical design reviews
needs: 9+ years in machine learning engineering, applied ML or a related field, with substantial production impact at scale
Senior Staff-level technical leadership: setting direction and aligning multiple teams without direct management authority
Strong fundamentals in large-scale recommendation/ads ranking, sequence modeling, graph learning, user/content understanding, calibration and knowledge distillation
Hands-on Python and PyTorch or TensorFlow, from data and label analysis to distributed training and production deployment
Practical experience using AI coding or agentic development tools to speed up ML work
nice: Direct experience in ads ranking, mid-funnel optimization (CTR/CVR/VTR) or multi-task/foundational ads architectures
details.benefits: Base salary $266,000 – $372,400 USD (the posting may span more than one career level). The role is eligible for equity as restricted stock units and, depending on the position, may be eligible for commission. Benefits include comprehensive healthcare and income replacement programs, a 401(k) with employer match, family planning support, gender-affirming care, mental health and coaching benefits, flexible vacation and paid volunteer time off, and generous paid parental leave.
notes: In select roles and locations, interviews may be recorded, transcribed and summarized by AI; candidates can opt out before interviews

lines: Remote role alert! Reddit wants a Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineer to lead the technical direction of its core ads ranking systems.
